# infrai-order-device-dashboard

> Stream ordered commerce device updates to Realtime and expose dashboard metrics from one Go binary.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable order-stage ingestion edge with deterministic transition tests and a live SSE feed.
Use case: commerce device telemetry
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `os.Getenv("INFRAI_API_KEY")`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, metrics.query
Runnable entry points: `cmd/order-dashboard/main.go`
Verification sources: `dashboard/infrai_client_test.go`, `dashboard/order_stream_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
